findings.title: Preserve context through actual workflow entrypoints
findings.summary: HTTP start/resume and ingest-to-resolve start omit nonempty RequestContext; child run tracing context is also lost. Direct resolve test bypasses production entrypoints.
findings.requested_fix: Forward installed API context through HTTP start/resume and ingest child start; prove correlation via real HTTP/ingest and approval resume.
findings.resolution_evidence: fix-1.json; actual Hono HTTP context/approval contracts; pending fresh independent review

findings.title: Honor documented optional approval body
findings.summary: OpenAPI requestBody.required=false conflicts with unconditional req.json(): absent body now returns400 despite previous valid default behavior.
findings.requested_fix: Empty body validates as {}; malformed nonempty JSON remains400/no resume. Test absent/valid/malformed bodies against actual handlers and route/OpenAPI contract agreement.
findings.resolution_evidence: fix-1.json; actual Hono HTTP context/approval contracts; pending fresh independent review

findings.title: Isolate database configuration before test module imports
findings.summary: Static caseStore/routes imports execute schema DDL and reads using inherited TURSO_DATABASE_URL/TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN or application ./mastra.db before test isolation. Also affects contract/support-api and integration/support-api.characterization suites.
findings.requested_fix: Set unique disposable local DB and clear inherited remote credentials before all application imports for affected test projects, or mock store before import. Prove inherited app database cannot receive test queries while retaining real temporary libSQL coverage.
findings.resolution_evidence: pr-fix-1.json; pre-import disposable DB setup and static-import regression; fresh review pending
